The subsequent AI-only single-frame serial attempt also stopped before import. A bounded endpoint-seam experiment then used five of six allowed image calls: no character layer passed the strict detached-low-alpha gate, the tatami was clipped, and the table geometry drifted, so no composite candidate or transition package exists.

technical.note: The four immutable endpoint digests and deterministic 596px standing receipt were reverified, but the endpoint-seam experiment failed its layer material gates before composition. No candidate, endpoint overlay/diff, full/reduced validation, interruption, route-isolation, or fallback test exists.
